site_name: Thamesmead and Abbey Wood Opportunity Area
evidence_slice: Greater London Authority's London Plan Opportunity Areas dataset describes Opportunity Areas as major brownfield locations with significant development capacity and provides custom polygon boundaries as a GeoPackage in British National Grid (EPSG:27700). The GLA's Thamesmead and Abbey Wood Opportunity Area page identifies the area across Bexley and Greenwich with London Plan indicative capacity for 8,000 homes and 4,000 jobs by 2041. Mayoral Decision MD2696, signed 1 December 2020, approved adoption of the Thamesmead and Abbey Wood Opportunity Area Planning Framework and records potential for 15,500 homes and 8,000 jobs with transport improvements.
binding_method: regional adopted Opportunity Area Planning Framework plus GLA custom-polygon Opportunity Areas dataset; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official GLA dataset and Opportunity Area/OAPF pages were accessed through public web transport; raw GeoPackage bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
